research_question: Does independent external evidence change the interpretation of the observed pre-2015 source-semantics failure?
search_scope: Independent post-result triangulation using CME settlement meaning, Databento historical/schema notes, and EIA regime evidence; no protected confirmation outcomes accessed.

sources.title: US shale gas and natural gas market changes 2010-2015

claim_map.claim: Daily settlement is a distinct venue statistic, so replacing it with another price field would change the experiment semantics rather than merely fill missing rows.
Historical vendor schemas and normalization have changed over time, supporting caution when treating old raw fields as automatically equivalent to current canonical fields.
The older period also spans structural natural-gas changes, so scientific transport would require its own justification even if source completeness were solved.

expected_observations: A source-semantics STOP should remain a STOP if external sources confirm that settlement identity matters and historical representation changed.
disconfirming_observations: Independent evidence shows the missing fields are semantically identical under the frozen definition and can be admitted without changing the experiment.
